items.title: 无人机群协同感知中针对从众型拜占庭攻击的安全防护
items.originalTitle: Securing Cooperative Sensing in UAV Swarms Against Conformity-Driven Byzantine Attacks
items.summary: 在ISAC使能的6G无人机群网络中，模仿型从众合作机制可能被拜占庭攻击者利用，制造虚假共识，导致正常无人机的有效错误概率动态演化，远超其固有感知误差，使基于独立性假设的传统融合方法失效。本文提出一种将演化博弈论与最大后验估计相结合的从众感知拜占庭鲁棒融合框架。
items.abstract: In integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) enabled 6G unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarm networks, the widely adopted imitation-based conformity cooperation mechanism can be exploited by Byzantine attackers to fabricate false consensus, causing the effective error probability of normal UAVs to evolve dynamically and far exceed their inherent sensing errors, which invalidates conventional fusion methods built on the independence assumption. This paper proposes a conformity-aware Byzantine-resilient fusion fram…
keyFacts: 如何防护无人机群协同感知中利用从众机制发起的拜占庭攻击？
将演化博弈论与最大后验估计相结合，构建从众感知的拜占庭鲁棒融合框架。
异质逐节点感知误差下，零阶演化稳定策略仅依赖误差均值；得到弱选择一阶修正和任意选择强度下的精确平均场不动点；攻击概率超过一半时群体级错误信息占优，阈值与感知误差及恶意比例无关；所提机制在不同网络拓扑、攻击强度、网络规模和感知误差分布下实现近100%情境推断精度，且在±20%参数失配下保持99%以上。

items.originalTitle: Spatial-Semantic Reasoning using Large Language Models for Efficient UAV Search Operations
items.summary: 面向无人机目标导航任务，提出实时语义导航框架。核心是LLM解析自然语言指令并对检测对象和空间上下文进行语义推理，优先搜索高概率区域。结合实时目标检测、3D空间映射和多项式样条插值实现平滑可行轨迹。实验表明在模拟和真实环境中减少任务时长并保持高搜索精度。
items.abstract: We present a real-time semantic navigation framework for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) focused on improving time efficiency in the Object Goal Navigation (ObjectNav) task. Central to our approach is a Large Language Model (LLM) that interprets user-provided natural language instructions and performs semantic reasoning over detected objects and spatial context to prioritize high-probability search regions. The system combines real-time object detection, 3D spatial mapping, and polynomial spline interpolation for…
keyFacts: 如何提高无人机目标导航的时间效率？
利用大型语言模型进行语义推理，优先高概率搜索区域，结合实时目标检测、3D空间映射和多项式样条插值。
在模拟和真实环境中，与先前方法相比，任务时长减少同时保持高搜索精度。

items.abstract: Low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite broadband, represented by Starlink, is making high-resolution video streaming feasible beyond fixed terrestrial coverage. However, Starlink access links change across time and regions, exposing adaptive bitrate (ABR) streaming to shifting throughput tails, latency, volatility, and handover conditions. Existing ABR controllers are usually designed, tuned, or trained for specific network conditions, making it difficult to handle newly exposed hard Starlink profiles. This paper propose…

However, evolving operator intents change which quantities-such as the…

However, traditional AutoFE often yield features with poor interpretability because they rely on blind mathematical transformations, while large language models (LLM)-based AutoFE f…

items.abstract: In financial markets, a sequential policy that reacts systematically to price movements may become predictable to other market participants. This paper studies whether large language model (LLM) agents exhibit such directional structure through RetailAgent, an experimental framework in which an LLM observes anonymized intraday equity price histories and permitted state, then repeatedly chooses long (hold the stock) or flat (stay out) before the subsequent interval return is revealed. We compare returns during long…
keyFacts: LLM交易代理的决策是否表现出可预测的方向性时序结构？
通过RetailAgent实验框架，LLM观察匿名日内价格历史并选择多头或空仓，使用暴露匹配度量，并打乱动作序列作为对照，同时引入自写记忆。

items.abstract: Predictive Process Monitoring (PPM) models are increasingly deployed in dynamic environments where concept drift causes the underlying process distribution to shift over time. While recent work has moved toward online continual learning, existing methods train compact, task-specific networks entirely from scratch, leaving a persistent cold-start problem. Foundation Models (FMs) offer a compelling solution to this problem, but their continual fine-tuning in the process mining domain remains unexplored. We propose C…

items.summary: 自洽薛定谔-泊松计算能预测半导体量子点器件行为，但全门电压扫描表征电荷稳定性图计算成本高。我们结合多域多模型方法与自动调谐程序，识别特定电荷构型对应的门电压，并用全组态相互作用计算提取充电能量、杠杆臂和量子点间库仑相互作用，直接参数化Hubbard模型，快速生成电荷稳定性图。在Intel Tunnel Falls Si/SiGe器件上，该方法以远低于电压偏置扫描的计算成本复现了电荷稳定性图，并与实验定性一致，向半导体量子点数字孪生模型迈进一步。该方法还扩展至第二种器件的杠杆臂工程。

However, characterization of charge stability diagrams through fully simulated gate-voltage sweeps is computationally expensive. Combining a Multi-Domain Multi-Model (MDMM) approach with an automated tuning routine, we identify gate voltages associated with selected charge configurations. keyFacts: 如何快速生成半导体量子点器件的电荷稳定性图，以降低计算成本并支持数字孪生模型？
结合多域多模型（MDMM）方法和自动调谐程序，进行少量自洽薛定谔-泊松模拟，并辅以全组态相互作用（FCI）能量计算，提取参数以参数化Hubbard模型，用于快速生成电荷稳定性图。
在Intel Tunnel Falls Si/SiGe器件上，Hubbard模型能以远低于电压偏置扫描的计算成本复现电荷稳定性图，并与实验数据定性一致；且该方法可扩展至第二种器件的杠杆臂工程。

items.title: 非线性电流诱导轨道磁化的量子几何起源
items.originalTitle: Quantum Geometric Origin of Nonlinear Current Induced Orbital Magnetization
items.summary: 电流产生磁化是凝聚态物理研究的焦点，最近已进入非线性领域。由于轨道磁性的非局域性，如何正确表述非线性电流诱导的轨道磁化仍是一个基本挑战。我们发展了该效应的正确理论，基于场修正布洛赫电子轨道磁矩的微观推导，填补了现有理论空白。研究表明，此现象的量子几何起源包括异常轨道极化率和贝里联络极化率，两者通常提供竞争性贡献。结合第一性原理计算，我们预测在应变双层石墨烯、单层1T' MoS2和MoTe2中可产生显著的实验可测非线性轨道磁化。值得注意的是，在具有拓扑带特征的材料中，非线性轨道磁化可超越其自旋对应物，无论自旋轨道耦合强度如何。
items.abstract: Electric generation of magnetization is a focus of condensed matter research, and has recently been advanced into the nonlinear regime. However, due to the nonlocal nature of orbital magnetism, how to properly formulate nonlinear current-induced orbital magnetization remains a fundamental challenge. Here, we develop the proper theory for this effect. 基于场修正布洛赫电子轨道磁矩的微观推导，结合第一性原理计算。
量子几何起源在于异常轨道极化率和贝里联络极化率；预测在应变双层石墨烯、单层1T' MoS2和MoTe2中产生显著非线性轨道磁化；在拓扑带材料中非线性轨道磁化可超越自旋对应物。

items.title: PAMoR：仿人机器人实时参数化情感动作生成
items.originalTitle: PAMoR: Parameterized Affective Motion Generation in Real Time for Humanoid Robots
items.summary: PAMoR将情感转化为可测量的控制参数：基于机器人运动学计算的价-唤醒（V-A）坐标，通过姿态扩展和运动能量闭合形式获得，无需人工标注。动作先验和两个情感先验在共享潜在空间训练，在每个去噪步骤组合。在29自由度Unitree G1上实时自回归生成全身动作，动作和情感均可编辑。生成动作在全程跟踪命令V-A，文本到动作保真度与文本基线相当。感知研究中，被试在0.38试验中识别命令情感，高于基线，接近真人0.44。
items.abstract: People read a humanoid robot's motion in social settings not only for the action performed but for the affect conveyed. Motion carrying that affect has so far been generated for human avatars, where style is taken from a reference clip or an emotion word, neither of which can be quantitatively parameterized. We present PAMoR, which turns affect into a measured control parameter: a valence-arousal (V-A) coordinate computed natively on robot kinematics. It is obtained in closed form from postural expansion and movem…
keyFacts: 如何将情感定量参数化并实时生成仿人机器人的情感动作？
提出PAMoR方法，将价-唤醒坐标作为控制参数，计算姿态扩展和运动能量，用动作先验和情感先验在共享潜在空间训练，在去噪步骤组合，自回归生成全身动作。
生成动作跟踪命令V-A全范围，文本到动作保真度与文本基线相当；感知研究中情感识别率0.38，高于基线，接近真人0.44。

items.originalTitle: Picking Bins Empty: A Hierarchical Hybrid Approach with Online Self-Learning of Grasp Points for Reliable Industrial Bin-Picking
items.summary: 针对工业料箱抓取中完全清空料箱的挑战，提出四层分层混合方法，结合基于模型和免模型方法。基于模型管道作为鲁棒骨干，免模型探索代理解决死锁并发现新抓取点。在线自学习机制利用夹爪行程反馈和Wilson分数区间自主排序抓取候选，减少人工调试。在三个汽车零件上验证，抓取成功率显著优于免模型基线，料箱清空率从50.9%提高到100%。
items.abstract: Bin-picking is a cornerstone of modern manufacturing, yet achieving complete bin clearance without manual intervention remains a critical challenge. While model-based methods provide high precision, they frequently suffer from deadlocks when predefined grasps are occluded or perception fails. Labor-intensive fine-tuning of grasp points is commonly required to reach a satisfactory performance for new parts. Model-free algorithms offer a more flexible alternative with "out-of-the-box" versatility but lack the reliab…
keyFacts: 如何实现工业料箱抓取的完全清空且无需人工干预？
提出四层分层混合方法，结合基于模型管道和免模型探索代理，用在线自学习机制（夹爪行程反馈和Wilson分数区间）排序抓取候选。
在三个汽车零件上，抓取成功率优于免模型基线，料箱清空率从50.9%提升至100%。

items.abstract: The Swing-UP of the quantum EmitteR population (SUPER) two-color pulsed excitation scheme allows for robust and close to 100\% excitation of a two-level quantum emitter using only red detuned light. We analyze the underlying counterintuitive dynamics using a full quantum input-output description of the in- and outgoing light pulses for the case of two coherent free-space input pulses at realistic photon numbers. At the microscopic level, the SUPER mechanism exhibits its nonlinear three-photon Raman-type character…
keyFacts: SUPER双色脉冲激发方案在自由空间中的微观动力学如何？需要多少光子数？

items.originalTitle: AutoDRI: Bridging the Semantic Gap for Automated Design Rule Integration in CP-SAT-Based Cell Synthesis under Multi-Patterning
items.summary: 设计规则集成是CP-SAT标准单元合成的主要瓶颈。我们提出AutoDRI，一个多智能体框架，结合几何语义库、标准化冲突集编码、构造性多色切割建模和反馈驱动流程，弥合自然语言设计规则与可执行CP-SAT约束之间的语义鸿沟。实验显示在41个单元基准上接近完美的规则集成正确性，并保持与手动编码相当的运行时间。
items.abstract: Design-rule integration (DRI) remains a major bottleneck for scalable (Constraint Programming with SAT) CP-SAT-based standard cell synthesis and rapid technology enablement at advanced nodes. It still depends heavily on manual effort and domain expertise. Moreover, existing low-level rule encodings are not expressive enough for emerging constraints such as cut-based rules under multi-patterning technology. keyFacts: 如何自动化设计规则集成，以应对先进节点多图案化下的新兴约束？

We update previous estimates of the long-GRB contribution to the Fermi-LAT isotropic gamma-ray background (IGRB), using a time-integrated high-energy afterglow template of GRB 221009A, anchored by GeV-TeV data, together with an explicitly specified scaling with prompt energy and beaming. Despite the observed multi-TeV afterglow, the cascade component reaches only 1.6e-4…
keyFacts: GRB 221009A的多TeV探测是否改变了长GRB对费米-拉特各向同性伽马射线背景（IGRB）的贡献估计？

items.title: 通过具有可调量子存储的最近邻自旋链：从量子储层计算到量子极限学习机
items.originalTitle: From quantum reservoirs to quantum extreme learning machines through a nearest-neighbor spin chain with tunable quantum memory
items.summary: 量子储层计算（QRC）通过量子系统的循环状态保留过去输入的存储，而量子极限学习机（QELM）在每个步骤重置系统，仅响应最近输入。我们表明它们是单一架构的两个极限，由输入编码长度连接。通过贝叶斯优化调整哈密顿量和演化时间，我们发现循环量子存储对需要远过去记忆的任务至关重要，而对短历史任务可忽略。最佳储层在混沌边缘运行，性能媲美随机全连接储层。
items.abstract: Quantum Reservoir Computing (QRC) processes temporal data by retaining a memory of past inputs in the recurrent state of a quantum system, whereas a Quantum Extreme-Learning Machine (QELM) discards that memory, resetting the system at every step so that only the most recent input shapes the response. The two are usually treated as separate computational paradigms. We show that they are the two limits of a single architecture, connected by the input-encoding length, that is, the number of qubits overwritten with fr…
keyFacts: QRC和QELM是否可以被统一为单一架构，以及量子存储对时序任务的作用？

QRC和QELM是同一架构的两个极限；循环量子存储对长时记忆任务必要，对短历史任务可忽略；最佳储层在混沌边缘运行，性能与全连接随机储层相当。
